hazards.name: Wide, straight roadway

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Installing bulb-outs at potential crossing points would shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk
interventions.description: Adding a high-visibility marked crossing would provide a designated and safer space for pedestrians to cross the wide street.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implementing vertical deflection would help maintain safe vehicle speeds in this residential area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or curb extensions to reduce vehicle speeds and improve pedestrian safety in this residential zone.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Ensure adequate street lighting is installed on existing utility poles to improve visibility for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Road Diet / Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to naturally slow traffic and potentially add a dedicated bike lane or wider buffer.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and signage to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-scale lighting
interventions.description: Install street lights to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Speed humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming to reduce vehicle speeds in the residential zone.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide physical separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of through lanes or narrow existing lanes to include a buffered bike lane or wider planting strip, slowing traffic and reducing crossing distance.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and pedestrian crossing signs to alert drivers and provide designated crossing points.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Removing parking spaces near crossing points to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting trees in the grass buffer zone to provide shade and naturally slow traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees between the new sidewalk and the roadway to provide a physical and psychological buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to alert drivers to pedestrian activity.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Refuge
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Vertical Elements
interventions.description: Add more street trees closer to the curb to create a sense of enclosure, which naturally encourages drivers to slow down.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reducing the width of travel lanes to encourage slower vehicle speeds and reduce the overall crossing distance.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation or Design
interventions.description: Ensuring driveways maintain the sidewalk level and material to reinforce pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk with Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian warning signs to alert drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.
